items.headline: The valuation read is being pulled by sentiment
items.detail: The composite sits at the 22th percentile, but the sentiment axis is at 73 while the rest average 28 — the one dimension running hot.
items.framing: Everything is cheap except sentiment, which reads 73/100. That divergence is the story — it's how the exchange-flow build-up first became visible.
items.checkable: Each axis is a percentile of its own history; published weights on the Methods page.

items.headline: 2 new proven top-timers in 90 days
items.detail: Wallet(s) that just crossed the ROI+capital bar by selling a top at profit — a burst means distribution is starting.
items.framing: 2 wallet(s) newly qualified as smart money in 90d (sold a top at ≥5× ROI). Low count = quiet market; a spike is the tell.
items.checkable: First crossing of the ROI+capital bar per wallet, from the sale history.

items.headline: SPX just moved into the Fire Sale band
items.detail: Price $0.444 crossed from BUY! into Fire Sale within the week — a band change the daily rotation won't announce on its own.
items.framing: SPX moved into the Fire Sale band this week. A clean "where are we on the rainbow" post even though no per-band fire triggered.
items.checkable: Current price vs the frozen power-law band edges (published model).

items.headline: -81% below its all-time high
items.detail: Deepest drawdown on record was -95%; it has made new highs after every prior one so far.
items.framing: Deep drawdowns are the toll — it's paid them before (no recovery promise).
items.note: It's deep and unrecovered NOW; don't imply it always recovers.

items.headline: Holders ~11% underwater — and still not selling
items.detail: MVRV 0.89: price is 11% below the crowd's avg on-chain cost basis ($0.499). Yet 58% of supply is in the longest-held tier — the float isn't moving.
items.framing: Maximum financial pain, minimal capitulation — conviction being tested and, so far, holding.
items.note: Describe the divergence, NOT a bottom call. "Not selling", not "buy".

items.headline: Perp funding above neutral by 17pp
items.detail: Funding 28% APR vs the ~11% neutral baseline — crowd leaning long.
items.framing: Where the derivatives crowd is positioned right now.

items.headline: SPX's MVRV 0.89 = 9th percentile of Bitcoin's history
items.detail: SPX's MVRV of 0.89 sits at the 9th percentile of Bitcoin's entire MVRV history — as cheap as BTC's generational bottoms.
items.framing: MVRV is unitless, so it's comparable: SPX today is at BTC's 9th percentile. BTC was only this cheap at major bottoms.
items.note: A position on BTC's map, not a date-match forecast.

items.headline: -81% below its long-run trend (Fire Sale band)
items.detail: Fair value for its age is $2.34; price sits -81% under it.
items.framing: Where today sits in the long power-law arc.

items.headline: 80% of all-time holders are gone — 92% of today's never sold to zero
items.detail: Of 26,910 wallets that ever held ≥5k SPX, 5,347 remain (80% churned). Yet 92% of CURRENT holders have never once sold to zero — survivorship.
items.framing: Enormous all-time churn, but the survivors are diamond-handed. The honest "who's still here" read.
items.note: Right-censoring: recent cohorts read high. "Gone" = fell below the 5k bar.

items.headline: Smart money still net-selling (-15.1% over 12w)
items.detail: The 10-wallet cohort of proven top-timers (ROI ≥5×, still holding) holds 6.96M SPX. 4w -13.2% · 12w -15.1% · 26w -22.5%.
items.framing: Smart money hasn't started buying yet (-15.1% in 12w). Honest "not the bottom signal yet" read.
items.checkable: A recomputed cohort of wallets with realized ROI ≥5× that still hold ≥50k SPX; net flow of their combined balance.

items.headline: A 1.77M-SPX holder moved everything to a new wallet of its own
items.detail: 2026-09-26 (1d ago). A test send, a test sent back, then the whole balance — the coins keep their age and cost, so it is not a sale and books no profit or loss.
items.framing: A 1.77M SPX position changed wallets on 2026-09-26: same holder, new address. Say "moved to a new wallet", never "sold" or "exited".
items.checkable: The handshake (small send, small send back, then the balance) is in the raw transfer history; both wallets are linked below.

items.headline: A whale added 772k SPX in 7 days
items.detail: 0xc044…d859 accumulated over the window, one of 3 whales net-buying.
items.framing: A large wallet accumulated 772k SPX in 7 days. Real, checkable buying by a big holder.
items.checkable: Net balance change on a watched wallet over the last week of transfers.

items.headline: NUPL -0.12 — capitulation
items.detail: Net unrealised profit/loss is -0.12 (from MVRV 0.89) — the market sits in the capitulation zone.
items.framing: Aggregate holder profitability. Below zero = the crowd is underwater, historically an accumulation zone.
items.note: A position read, not a signal.

items.headline: The base is sitting tighter than usual
items.detail: Liveliness 0.611 is 1.4σ down vs its month. Rising = old coins moving (distribution/rotation); falling = holders sitting still (accumulation).
items.framing: Coins are sitting tighter — liveliness fell. The base is holding, dormancy deepening.
items.checkable: Coin-days-destroyed vs coin-days-stored from the FIFO reconstruction.

items.headline: -1.2σ below its trend vs the alt market
items.detail: SPX ÷ the alt sector (ex-BTC/ETH/stables), detrended, sits 1.2σ below its own trend — cheap vs alts.
items.framing: Relative value vs the whole alt sector — -1.2σ cheap. SPX structurally outperforms alts, so this is deviation from ITS trend, not parity.
items.note: A relative-value position, not a signal.

items.headline: SOPR 0.805 — coins moving at a loss
items.detail: Spent-output profit ratio is 0.805: coins that moved on-chain realised a loss on average. Sustained <1 = capitulation, >1 = profit-taking.
items.framing: On-chain realised behaviour — loss-realisation (SOPR 0.805).
items.note: Only coins that MOVED; a behaviour read, not a signal.
